survey: A folding camp chair, seen at three-quarter view from the front left, standing on a flat beige surface. The backrest is a green fabric panel wrapped around a top cross tube. It hangs between two silver uprights. Each upright runs down to the back corner of the seat and carries on below it as one leg of an X, ending at a front foot. The seat is a green fabric sling. Its front edge is wrapped around a capped cross tube, and its back edge meets the uprights. From each end of the front seat tube, a second leg runs down and back to a rear foot. On each side the two legs cross at a pivot sleeve, so the two sides form matching X frames. A bottom rail joins the two front feet and another joins the two rear feet, each ending in grey end caps. All four feet touch the ground and the chair casts a shadow. There are no extra parts or loose fabric ends, and the frame could both stand and fold flat on its pivots.
